items.quote: Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
items.claim: Moses expresses doubt about his capability to go to Pharaoh and bring forth the Israelites

items.quote: Certainly I will be with thee
this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee
items.claim: God's presence serves as a sign that God commissioned Moses

items.quote: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt
items.claim: Moses will lead the people out of Egypt

items.quote: ye shall serve God upon this mountain
items.claim: After leaving Egypt, the people will worship God at a specific mountain
